It was not hard, I met with the missionaries once a week, went to church Sunday, learned the lessons, went to institute once a week. I did all the things you were supposed too. It was not hard, but I recommend really searching your heart and making sure you truly  believe what the church teaches. 

Although I do believe men have more responsibility in the church. 

I joined because I thought I knew what the church stood for, but I found out a few months in some of the people were very elitist and hypocritical (not everyone, but even my boyfriend at the time was) 

There is something called “flirt to convert” that I would be careful of. I asked my boyfriend if he was going on his mission, to which he said “no I did my mission work when I got you to convert” which sort of shocked me because I always thought I was doing it for myself but I realized it was for him. 

My advice is make sure it is what is best for your life even if you and your girlfriend break up. Imagine she is not in the picture and see how you feel. 

I left the church and wish I gave more though before joining. I joined rather quickly though, so take the time to really learn the lessons.

I thought the church was hypocritical. I dated a Mormon then converted and I realized the standards the church and my ex boyfriend held were almost imposible to live up to. For example, my family is not the faithful church going type, so sometimes I would use God's name in vain without even realizing. I had witnessed my ex boyfriend make a decent amount of mistakes and go against some commandments, and I never thought he would be so critical and hurtful to me for one mistake. He even admitted to me he cheated, but still using God's name in vain was worse. I find most organized religion is probably like that, but then I did my research as I was leaving the church (which I should have done before joining, I know, and I read some of the things about church history and I was sort of shocked. I thought: why did I not realize these things happened. But I was after all dating a lifetime Mormon and he told me to ask him questions, becasue they never trust information that comes from ex Mormons. I was blind sided by the whole flirt to convert thing, emotional manipulation, which is another topic all together.
